name: NeuroTranslate 0.0 shared movement-distance experiment, edition 1
study_scope: Offline motion-only shared checkpoint. HoloAssist localized right wrist in three dimensions and JS14 tracked position in two dimensions are separate recording-derived targets, never a simultaneous cross-species signal.
admission: Use only original 29 HoloAssist TRAIN sessions. Reuse the preceding-words acquisition groups R035,R037,R042,R045,R072,R074 for assessment; all other original TRAIN groups are eligible for train, subject to original provenance exclusions in the prospective data freeze. JS14 epoch 5 trips 55–78 train and 81–89 reused assessment; 80 excluded. No prior HoloAssist review/reserve, rat gaps/reserve, fitting on assessment, validation, tuning or model selection.
observations: Data owner samples cutoff anchors every 2 s from +2 s, uses five recent observations from cutoff-1.00 to cutoff in 0.25 s steps and the observation at nominal cutoff+0.25 s, each latest valid at or before its requested time, at most 0.050 s stale on the native recording-relative clock. Target endpoint elapsed time must be within [.200,.300] native seconds. Preserve Holo RGB grid separately for clock checks. One recording only; ascending distinct observed clocks, bounded actual durations, HoloAssist deduplicated source ticks; scorable complete histories only. Future controls target availability only. y is the distance in cm between observed endpoints. Upstream eligibility, split, counts and actual time distributions must be verified before release.
features: 4 tokens in chronological order. Raw channels = step length cm, actual native duration s, ending observation's age on the native clock s, two-step chord cm, signed turn cosine. The first has no previous step: two-step chord and cosine set zero; zero-length turns have cosine zero. No absolute position, axis, subject, trial, caption, spike, unknown future lead or session/task ID. Domain selects only one of two output heads. Fixed transforms, independent of data: log1p(step cm), (dt-.25)/.05, age/.05, log1p(two-step cm), cosine, log1p(0.25*step/dt). No learned normalization on assessment or other-domain values.

architecture.network: input linear; learned positions; pre-LayerNorm(eps 1e-5), full multihead self-attention over the four observed tokens, residual; pre-LayerNorm, ReLU feedforward, residual; final last-token LayerNorm; domain-selected linear head (zero initialized) outputs log-distance correction to log1p(recent movement). The domain only selects that final head. One state, one common encoder. No dropout.
architecture.prediction: expm1(max(0,corrected log1p distance)); residual baseline = last step cm / its actual duration * (.25 + ending observation age s).

fit.optimizer: AdamW lr .001, betas (.9,.999), eps 1e-8, weight_decay .001, no gradient clipping or early stop
fit.loss: smooth L1 beta 0.2 of unconstrained log output against log1p(y cm); joint = half the mean for each domain, solo = half the own-domain mean (matches own-domain contribution).
fit.sampler: For each seed and domain, draw 400 x 64 row indices with replacement: draw a training group uniformly, then a row uniformly within it. Joint and exposure-matched solos use the identical first 32 indices at each step; total-compute solos use all 64. Use independent RNGs seeded from seed and domain. One jointly trained checkpoint and four solo fits per seed, same initial tensor values and model parameter slots. No later seed or checkpoint selection. Report row/group counts, exact opportunity counts and distinct rows. Train once per arm plus separate speed probes that never export trained states.

controls: Persistence predicts zero distance. Recent movement extrapolates last segment through nominal lead plus origin age. Fit two fixed group-equal, domain-only ridge models to raw distance and log1p(distance); both see the same histories. Flatten transformed token features plus raw lengths, speeds scaled to a quarter second, two-step lengths, recent extrapolation and summary mean/median/max over lengths and extrapolated lengths. Standardize predictors with per-domain TRAIN group-equal weighted mean/SD, constant SD set 1. Unpenalized intercept; weighted mean squared loss + .01 L2. Clamp negative cm predictions to zero. No tuned hyperparameters.
assessment: Primary MAE in cm, average within acquisition R group / rat trip, then equally across groups in each domain. Show all groups, ordinary window-weighted MAE, and paired joint minus baseline differences. Primary deployed seed 27181, report each seed and three-seed mean as sensitivity. Reuse-only comparison; one rat session and acquisition groups not established independent people. No population or clinical inference.
uncertainty: For primary seed, paired differences on the same groups. Empirical 2.5/97.5 percentiles from 10000 paired bootstrap replicates, fixed seed 7331. Human resamples acquisition groups with replacement; rat ordinary circular moving blocks of 3 consecutive ordered trips until length 9. Intervals describe sensitivity within this reused material; overlap/dependence and a single animal limit interpretation. Also report sign count and leave-one-group range.
transfer_decision: Support for improvement in one domain requires deployed seed joint macro MAE strictly lower than both matched solos with upper paired interval <0 for both, and both contrasts strictly favorable for each of the other two seeds. Report each domain separately, including degradation and inconclusive results. Bidirectional positive transfer requires both domains pass. Separate useful-prediction gate uses primary joint lower macro MAE than persistence, recent movement and both ridge baselines in that domain. A joint model fitting both domains alone establishes computational compatibility only.
deployment: Portable no-pickle NPZ containing the one preselected joint checkpoint, separate fit/replay code, two data-derived reference inputs selected from TRAIN by domain in original order, and inference cross-check. Preserve domain order and sensor-specific units. No control or clinical application.
preoutcome: The author read schema, source role histories and existing published protocols, and has not opened response or assessment arrays for this question. Protocol written before fitting or scoring. Independent scientific and source-code review retained.
